_doc: Bambu Lab PETG HF, printed, for analysis: stiffness and strength along the layers (x-y) and across them (z). Printed values vary with the printer, settings and spool: measure your own (the lever bench does) and record it as kind measured.
name: petg

modulus.source: Bambu Lab PETG HF technical data sheet V1.0 (ISO 527), https://store.bblcdn.com/3a230e260a3a47c2b0db0156e07eef91.pdf

modulus_z.source: Bambu Lab PETG HF technical data sheet V1.0 (ISO 527)

strength.source: Bambu Lab PETG HF technical data sheet V1.0 (ISO 527)

strength_z.source: Bambu Lab PETG HF technical data sheet V1.0 (ISO 527)

poisson.source: Typical for PETG; printed parts vary

density.source: Typical for PETG (1.23 to 1.29 g/cm³ across makers' data sheets)

softening.rule: Heat deflection temperature, ISO 75 at 0.45 MPa: where a part under a little load starts to creep
softening.source: Bambu PETG HF technical data, ISO 75 at 0.45 MPa, https://bambulab.com/hu/filament/guide

cost.rule: What a kilogram of it costs, so a printed part's cost can stand beside a bought one's: Bambu Lab PETG Basic as a 1 kg refill, 12.99 EUR with VAT on its EU store on the date checked (a spool with it costs 3 EUR more). Another maker's or shop's will differ: set your own
cost.source: Bambu Lab EU store, PETG Basic filament page, https://eu.store.bambulab.com/products/petg-basic
